requirements.summary: ADR-0041 owns the shared control-plane ownership pattern and Bootstrap execution boundary without defining TDD Adapter semantics or allocating a colliding ADR ID.
requirements.evidence_intent: Existing Accepted ADR citation, collision fixture, and ownership validation.

requirements.summary: Standards, repository-owned Skills, plan instances, compatibility adapters, and logs have distinct owners.
requirements.evidence_intent: Unique-owner registry, compatibility-boundary projection, and negative duplicate-owner fixture.

requirements.summary: Each participating plan owns one compact implementation-contract instance.
requirements.evidence_intent: Valid self-hosted instance and three shadow instances.

requirements.summary: Commands are structured, shell-free, allowlisted, and typed.
requirements.evidence_intent: Shell, env, raw-string, and placeholder fixtures.

requirements.summary: Adapter v1 is stateless, in-session, recoverable, and has no provider scheduler.
requirements.evidence_intent: No-provider/no-hidden-state contract and recovery tests.

requirements.summary: Prepare fails closed on invalid authority, contract, predecessor, path, command, hash, or blocker state.
requirements.evidence_intent: Prepare negative fixtures and structured diagnostics.

requirements.summary: Production writes require an observed expected RED.
requirements.evidence_intent: Observed expected failure ID and RED result envelope.

requirements.summary: GREEN uses current RED evidence and the smallest declared production write set.
requirements.evidence_intent: Stale-RED and out-of-write-set fixtures.

requirements.summary: REFACTOR begins after GREEN and preserves declared regressions.
requirements.evidence_intent: Transition and regression-preservation tests.

requirements.summary: Candidate envelope authorizes Bootstrap review only.
requirements.evidence_intent: Exact authorizes/does-not-authorize envelope test.

requirements.summary: Implementation backend owns no review, done, commit, acceptance, or release transition.
requirements.evidence_intent: Forbidden-authority mutation fixture.

requirements.summary: Bootstrap remains the sole semantic-review authority and exposes one repository-owned finalized-run validation envelope.
requirements.evidence_intent: Review exclusivity, required-check integration, complete profile projection, and non-authorizing finalized envelope evidence.

requirements.summary: Plan validator exposes four exact predicates without release authority.
requirements.evidence_intent: Exact predicate authority-set fixtures.

requirements.summary: Baseline freezes Git/index/closure identity and byte-verifiable per-file snapshots for diff recomputation.
requirements.evidence_intent: Index/read/dependency/write drift plus stale before/after byte-hash fixtures.

requirements.summary: Recovery preserves stale runs and starts linked successors normally.
requirements.evidence_intent: Stale predecessor and non-stale successor tests.

requirements.summary: Acceptance consumes a current finalized-run envelope and blocks on open P0/P1 or invalid P2 disposition.
requirements.evidence_intent: Stale envelope/profile/artifact, open blocker, high-risk, expired, and valid-deferral fixtures.

requirements.summary: Backfill 7-12, 7-07, and 7-11 additively in shadow mode.
requirements.evidence_intent: Byte-preservation and non-authoritative shadow evidence.

requirements.summary: Adapter and validator use positive, negative, boundary, stale, mutation, and pressure scenarios.
requirements.evidence_intent: Fixture matrix and executed unit/mutation suite.

requirements.summary: This plan owns P0-P3; BMAD removal is a separate P4 plan.
requirements.evidence_intent: Phase registry rejects P4 activation.

requirements.summary: Confidence is advisory and bounded to three improvement rounds.
requirements.evidence_intent: Confidence cannot alter predicate result test.

requirements.summary: Plan intent and immutable refs stay separate from logs-owned mutable evidence.
requirements.evidence_intent: Path ownership and mutable-state rejection tests.

requirements.summary: Preserve and hash-bind agentbuild.txt as the single original intent source.
requirements.evidence_intent: Current source hash and unique source path check.

requirements.summary: Windows paths remain contained, normalized, protected, and reparse-safe.
requirements.evidence_intent: Case, containment, overlap, and reparse fixtures.

requirements.summary: Reject a top-level Router and new authority in historical script directories.
requirements.evidence_intent: ADR and forbidden-owner/path fixture.

requirements.summary: Each backend invocation consumes an immutable Capsule whose typed artifact refs exactly close over byte-verified context.
requirements.evidence_intent: Actual-byte, exact-union, duplicate, typed-root, blocker-ref, authority, and predecessor fixtures.

requirements.summary: Attempts form a complete RED-GREEN-REFACTOR prefix with exact event lifecycle, recomputed diff facts, and ledger-root candidate binding.
requirements.evidence_intent: Stage order/completeness, lifecycle, event bytes, response/diff/command/scope, before/after hash, decision binding, and ledger-root fixtures.
